description: Envoy process, connections, requests and limits of the Apoxy gateway backplane.

panels.title: Envoy up
panels.description: The backplane answers the scrape while Envoy restarts, so 0 is a real value and not a lost scrape.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Envoy starts after an exit, counted since the backplane started.

panels.title: Envoy admin scrape errors
panels.description: The backplane could not read the Envoy admin API. The scrape still answers with the backplane metrics, so the Envoy stats are missing for that scrape.

panels.title: Exits by reason and code
panels.description: reason is exit, signal, oom_kill or start_failed. code is the exit status or the signal name.

panels.title: Last exit facts
panels.description: The requests and the connections come from the last sample before the exit. The aborted and refused counts come from the kernel counters of the pod over the down window.

panels.title: Downstream connection pressure
panels.description: The overload manager writes the pressure as a percent from 0 to 100. Envoy refuses new connections at 100.

panels.title: TCP resets and aborts
panels.description: Kernel counters of the pod network namespace. A reset reaches the caller through the load balancer.

panels.title: Accept queue overflows and drops
panels.description: The kernel drops a connection when Envoy does not accept it fast enough. This moves before any Envoy stat.

panels.title: Time inside the proxy, p99

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(envoy_http_downstream_rq_time_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))) - histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_time_bucket{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: The difference holds the filter chain, the connection setup and the wait in the pending queue. Read it with the connect time and the pending panels.

panels.title: Queue and connection overflow
panels.description: An overflow is a request that Envoy answers with 503 without an upstream attempt.

panels.title: Upstream connect failures
panels.description: Ephemeral ports of the node and conntrack limits show here first.

panels.title: Open circuit breakers
panels.description: 1 means the breaker is open and Envoy refuses the next request.

panels.title: Remaining budget
panels.description: The gauges exist because the translator sets track_remaining on every cluster.

panels.title: Hosts in the cache vs max_hosts
panels.description: Envoy writes the cache name into the metric name, so the query builds a cache label from it. The backplane reports the limit with the cache name as a label.

panels.title: Hosts removed to make room
panels.description: The cache is full. Envoy resolves the removed host again on the next request.

panels.title: Heap pressure
panels.description: The overload manager writes the pressure as a percent from 0 to 100. The heap monitor counts the tcmalloc heap only, so plugin memory does not show here.

panels.title: Process memory vs container limit
panels.description: Resident memory holds the heap, the Go runtime and every loaded plugin. The kernel kills the process at the limit.

panels.title: File descriptors
panels.description: Every downstream and upstream connection holds one descriptor.

panels.title: Overload actions active
panels.description: 1 means the action runs. The action is a flag, not a percent.

panels.title: Watchdog misses
panels.description: A thread did not answer the watchdog. Requests on that worker wait for the whole stop. Envoy counts every thread together and once per thread, so the query reads the total only.

panels.title: Downstream connections on the server
panels.description: The connections open now, over every listener.

panels.title: Rejected configuration updates
panels.description: Envoy keeps the last good configuration, so the proxy serves stale routes after a rejection.

panels.title: Listener changes and drains
panels.description: A connection on a draining listener closes at the end of the drain, even when the upstream still answers.

title: Apoxy gateway - Envoy
